target_customer: Retail consumers who want hands-off investing tied to their spending
problem: Everyday people find investing decisions and market timing stressful, so they do not invest or buy and sell badly.
business_model: Consumer subscription, plans from 19.99 to 159.99 USD per month per the company site
product_category: Automated investing and spending-linked sweep account (consumer fintech, crypto exchange connected)

founders.name: Michael Shattuck
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder and describes over a decade as a software engineer with machine learning and enterprise architecture experience. No education or employers listed.

founders.name: Aaron Bylund
founders.background_notes: Utah Business 2022-04-15 names him as founder and describes him and co-founders as working professionals in their early 20s who began with Robinhood and Coinbase. Not on the YC page, so the role is uncertain.

competitors.name: Acorns
competitors.what: Round-up micro-investing app; TechBuzz contrasts it with Soon, which invests daily by dollar cost averaging

competitors.name: Robinhood and Coinbase
competitors.what: Direct brokerage and crypto exchange apps the founders used before building Soon; Utah Business also compares Soon to Chime, SoFi, Public, Betterment and Wealthfront

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting bank spending signals to exchange APIs and automated trading is standard fintech integration work with some hard parts around reliability and tax tracking.

defensibility.rationale: The concept of auto investing on schedules is widely copyable and Soon is non-custodial, so users can switch exchanges or apps easily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents offered recurring buys and round-ups; no source shows a specific copy or acquisition of Soon.

market_need_then: Utah Business in 2022-04 describes a first quarter 2022 market drop and founders who found investing hard after using Robinhood and Coinbase. Consumer demand is evidenced only by founder statements.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word used by many products, including a Soon fasting app on Product Hunt. No evidence of community or brand press beyond launch coverage.

pivots.from: Sweep account that invests on spending signals
pivots.to: Soon Smart Debit Account and crypto auto-trading tooling
pivots.why: Not stated. Inferred from the Product Hunt listing (2023-03-15 launch) and the current site, so treat as uncertain.

outcome_analysis: Soon is still listed as active with four people and a small angel round. It remains a thin consumer fintech with a generic name against well funded incumbents, and its current site frames it as a crypto automation tool rather than the original sweep account. No shutdown or acquisition was found, and later rounds are not found, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: Funding: Benzinga and Future Nexus both report about 1 million USD from Utah angels in 2021, while TechBuzz says above 900K and CB Insights lists 1.2M total with a convertible note, so the amount is approximate. FundedIQ shows a 500K pre-seed in 2022-02, likely the YC deal. Founder conflict: YC page lists Michael Shattuck only, Utah Business names Aaron Bylund. No outcome news found.
